exposure: Timing of first maternal-newborn contact (seeing, holding, feeding)
outcome: Birth experience (measured by the FBS Birth Experience Scale)
cohort: Nearly 3000 women who delivered in Pennsylvania between 2009-2011
finding: Earlier maternal-newborn contact after delivery was associated with more positive childbirth experiences, especially for women who delivered by cesarean.
mod_finding: Women who delivered by cesarean were less likely to have early contact with their newborns and reported less positive birth experiences overall, but early contact mitigated this difference.
